agents.label: t12-attr
agents.task: Implement rerank-pack plan Scope/Step 1 only: NEW src/openlens/plugins/attribute_enricher.py AttributeEnricher (ENRICHMENT stage, optional). Normalizes product/hotel/article metadata into documented keys (price, currency, location, facilities, published, perspective); missing attributes degrade to documented neutral sentinels; unparseable values keep the raw string plus a warning, never raise; never emits trust warnings (no overlap with trust-enricher). Parse once here — rerankers read the normalized keys, never re-parse raw metadata. Tests in NEW tests/unit/test_rerank_attr.py: each attribute class, missing -> sentinel, unparseable -> raw + warning, deterministic output. Shares ENRICHMENT with trust-enricher as independent (no dependencies). No registry/config/ranker changes.
agents.done: attribute_enricher.py + tests green; normalized keys documented in module docstring.

agents.label: t12-diversity
agents.task: Implement rerank-pack plan Scope/Step 2 only: NEW src/openlens/plugins/diversity_reranker.py DiversityReranker (EXPLANATION stage, optional). Soft per-domain demotion as a diversity ordering signal in the shared 0..1 signals namespace (reuse plugins/_signals.py get/set): signal = 1/(1+prior_same_domain_count) counted in incoming order (first per domain 1.0, then 0.5, 0.33...), so rank-1 is never demoted by diversity alone. Single O(n) dict pass. No hit is ever removed or excluded. Signals only — no private re-sort of context.results. Tests in NEW tests/unit/test_rerank_diversity.py: exact signal values on a hand-built 6-hit list (1.0/0.5/0.33...), rank-1 stability, no removal. No registry/config/ranker changes.

agents.label: t12-news
agents.task: Implement rerank-pack plan Scope/Step 3 only: NEW src/openlens/plugins/news_reranker.py NewsReranker (EXPLANATION stage, optional; reads enriched attributes from the attribute enricher's documented keys — same-pass RANKING placement is impossible, EXPLANATION is the pinned home). Story grouping over top-K candidates (K=50, configurable): tokenize titles, build word bigrams, bigram->candidate index, union-find merge pairs sharing >=1 bigram with title-token Jaccard >= 0.5 and same normalized published date (or both undated); blocks over 25 candidates left unmerged; hits beyond K get no story_id. Perspective mix weighted by credibility: consume the scoring-pack graded trust signal with trusted-bool fallback (trust absent -> 1.0/0.5 from metadata trusted, else 0.5) — never equal-weight; missing perspective normalizes to 'unknown'. Emits 0..1 perspective ordering signal (most credible member of each perspective per group gets its credibility, other same-perspective members half, ungrouped hits neutral 0.5) plus context.metadata['story_groups'] (group id -> member ids + perspective labels) and per-result metadata['story_id'] (internal only, asserted on SearchContext, NOT API diagnostics). Pure signal functions kept stage-agnostic. Tests in NEW tests/unit/test_rerank_news.py: grouping on near-duplicate titles per the pinned rule, credibility-weighted mix with a distrusted outlier ranked below, story_groups shape on metadata, K-cap behavior, trusted-bool fallback with signals absent. No registry/config/ranker changes.
agents.done: news_reranker.py + grouping/credibility tests green; story_groups internal.

agents.label: t12-commerce
agents.task: Implement rerank-pack plan Scope/Step 4 only: NEW src/openlens/plugins/commerce_reranker.py CommerceReranker (EXPLANATION stage, optional; reads enriched attributes from the attribute enricher's documented keys). Budget (max_price filter), location, facilities (facilities: list[str] filter) constraints from request filters (already reserved pass-through by filter-pack T10; consumes them, never validates the schema) + normalized attributes -> commerce ordering signal (satisfied fraction of requested constraints; no constraints requested -> neutral 0.5) with cited reasons ('within your budget', 'matches location'). Price compares only when currencies match (or filter carries no currency); mismatch -> neutral with a reason; location match is case-insensitive equality on normalized value. Constraints unsatisfied -> demote, never exclude. Missing attributes fall back to keyword behavior with a reason saying so. Tests in NEW tests/unit/test_rerank_commerce.py: budget/location/facilities reorder with cited reasons on hand-built hits with price/currency/location metadata, currency mismatch neutral, keyword fallback with reason. No registry/config/ranker changes.
